experiment: 015-midlayer-probe (E6, Amendment 15 of docs/04-phase4-plan.md; exploratory under D-016)
feature_layout: 004 secondary = [blk4 CLS|blk4 mean|blk8 CLS|blk8 mean|blk12 CLS|blk12 mean], H=768; block 12 == B0 primary

sources.all: train reals = VISION natives + RAISE (b0_train recipe)

probe: lib/probe.fit_probe: StandardScaler + LogisticRegressionCV (Cs=logspace(-4,1,6), 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold, AUROC), class_weight=balanced, groups = device (VISION) / caption id (RAISE real + all its fakes) / image
b0_literal_003: fit_probe(X_last_clean[b0_train], y) with no groups, no class weights (003 run.py stage_b0); LOGO = b0_train minus g. Secondary comparator only.
split_rule: Official 003/004 split kept for every row without a caption id. A caption family (RAISE real + every fake with the same r<hex>t id, all generators incl. FLUX) goes on the TRAIN side if it has more official-train rows than official-calib/test rows, else on the EVAL side (ties -> eval). Only rows whose official split matches the side are kept; the others are dropped from E6.
primary_reals: test reals of pools vision_native + raise (003 test-real convention); per-pool rows: native, WA, FBH, RAISE; cross-source: RAISE-only model -> native+WA+FBH test reals, VISION-only model -> RAISE test reals
macro: LOGO-macro = mean AUROC over 7 train generators (their LOGO model) + FLUX ('full' model); macro7 (without FLUX) reported as sensitivity
fpr_threshold: FPR 1% on pooled calib reals (clean scores) of the same model; FPR per pool with Clopper-Pearson 95% CI; model = 'full' (FLUX unseen)
twin_pairs: RAISE test reals and the test fakes with the same caption id; per-generator AUROC (LOGO model of that generator) pooled over generators weighted by pairs; bootstrap over caption ids
texture: mean |4-neighbour Laplacian| of the grayscale 224 center crop of the conditioned image (009 lap224); sign from calib reals vs train fakes; gate uses max over both signs

predictions.P1: label arm orig, F_b8 T-aug vs B0 at jpeg75_resize05: LOGO-macro gain >= 0.03 AND FLUX gain >= 0.03, clean loss <= 0.01, CI lower bounds of both gains > 0
predictions.P2: twin-paired laundered AUROC >= 0.85 AND cross-source laundered AUROC >= 0.85 in both directions (else real-source-specific)
predictions.P3: FPR at pooled 1% calib threshold <= 2% on every real pool at jpeg75_resize05
gates: labels not fragile to dropping any one generator
